parameters.help_en:
The SMS signature name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html operation to query the signatures that are created for the current account or view the signature list in the SMS console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign).
The signature must have passed the review

短信签名名称。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html接口查询当前账号已申请的签名或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)查看签名列表。
必须是通过审核的短信签名

parameters.name: card_template_code

parameters.help_en:
The template code for the fallback text short message. This parameter is required when FallbackType is set to SMS for falling back to a text short message.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html operation to query the templates that are created for the current account or view the template list in the SMS console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template).
The template must have been added and passed the review
parameters.help_zh:
回落文本短信的模板Code。FallbackType选择SMS回落文本短信时，此参数必填。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419288.html接口查询当前账号已申请的模板或在短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template)查看模板列表。
必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信模板
parameters.name: sms_template_code

parameters.help_en:
The uplink short message extension code. Uplink short messages are messages sent to a telecommunications service provider to subscribe to a service, complete a query, or handle a business. Uplink short messages are charged based on the standard SMS rates of the carrier.
Ignore this field if you do not have the preceding requirements
parameters.help_zh:
上行短信扩展码。上行短信，指发送给通信服务提供商的短信，用于定制某种服务、完成查询，或是办理某种业务等，需要收费的，按运营商普通短信资费进行扣费。
无上述需求的用户请忽略此字段
parameters.name: sms_up_extend_code

parameters.help_en:
The fallback type. Valid values:
SMS: falls back to a text short message for phone numbers that do not support card short messages.
DIGITALSMS: falls back to a digital short message for phone numbers that do not support card short messages.
NONE: no fallback
parameters.help_zh:
回落类型。取值：
SMS：不支持卡片短信的号码，回落文本短信。
DIGITALSMS：不支持卡片短信的号码，回落数字短信。
NONE：不需要回落
parameters.name: fallback_type

parameters.help_en:
The template code for the fallback digital short message. This parameter is required when FallbackType is set to DIGITALSMS for falling back to a digital short message.

You can view the digital short message template list on the Template management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/digit) page under Digital SMS in the console.

The template must have been added and passed the review
parameters.help_zh:
回落数字短信的模板Code。FallbackType选择DIGITALSMS回落数字短信时，此参数必填。

您可在控制台数字短信模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/digit)页面查看数字短信模板列表。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的数字短信模板
parameters.name: digital_template_code

If the JSON string needs to contain line breaks, follow the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
回落文本短信的模板变量对应的实际值。SmsTemplateCode回落的文本短信模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。

parameters.name: sms_template_param

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the template variables in the fallback digital short message template. This parameter is required when the digital short message template specified by DigitalTemplateCode contains variables.

If the JSON string needs to contain line breaks, follow the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
回落数字短信的模板变量对应的实际值。DigitalTemplateCode回落的数字短信模板内含有变量时，此参数必填。

如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: digital_template_param

parameters.help_en:
The template code for custom message content.

Custom content is delivered to the terminal in the format of the selected text short message template plus the card parsing link. Log on to the SMS console (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/overview), select Domestic Messages or International/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan Messages, and view the Template CODE on the Template Management tab.

The template code must have been added and passed the review. When sending international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages, use the corresponding international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan SMS template.
Example: If the selected text short message template content is "You have a message to check" and the card parsing link is `1*.cn/2**d`, the final delivered content is `You have a message to check 1*.cn/2**d`. Test and control the character count before sending
parameters.help_zh:
自定义发送内容模板CODE。

自定义内容会按照选定的文本短信模板+卡片解析链接的形式下发到终端，您可以登录短信服务控制台 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/overview)，选择国内消息或国际/港澳台短信，在模板管理页签下查看模板CODE。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的模板CODE；且发送国际/港澳台消息时，请使用国际/港澳台短信模版。
例如：选择的文本短信模板内容为：您有一条消息待查收；卡片解析链接为：`1*.cn/2**d`。最终下发内容：`您有一条消息待查收1*.cn/2**d`。请在下发前做好测试和字数控制
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en:
The actual values of the template variables in the custom message content template. This parameter is required when the SMS template specified by TemplateCode contains variables.

If the JSON string needs to contain line breaks, follow the standard JSON protocol
parameters.help_zh:
自定义发送内容模板变量对应的实际值。TemplateCode填入包含变量的短信模板时，此参数必填。

如果JSON中需要带换行符，请参照标准的JSON协议处理
parameters.name: template_param
